_source: posting-runbook.md §2. Slots must be members of SLOTS_CAIRO in build/manifest-schema.mjs, which is also what the publish workflow's eight crons fire on.

middle._note: Conditional. The card holds eight rows, so it is skipped until eight prices have moved.

settleDay._note: The weekly prize. STAT card, not P_WINNER_THEIR_TEAM: that one needs the winner's XI from an auth-gated endpoint.

_tiktok: TikTok takes a 1080x1920 story card for every kind that has one — see STORY_BUILDERS in plan.mjs. Matchday and results joined on 2026-09-02 once build-cards.py grew short row variants of their story cards; before that the only layouts held eight and four rows.
_settleDay: The prize post leads the day. Owner call, 2026-09-02: the round's winner is what the audience is waiting for once a gameweek settles, so it goes out first rather than third. Settlement itself runs around 01:00 Cairo and the day starts at noon, so 12:00 is as immediate as the grid allows.
_freshness: freshWithinHours holds back a card whose data keeps moving until its slot is close. A card is a snapshot and mergePosts keeps it, so one authored four days early publishes what was true when it rendered. Prices are a rolling 168h window, hence 24h; the table needs the previous round finished, hence 48h plus its own completeness check in plan.mjs.
